verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers formation filings, annual-report edits (officers, registered agent, addresses) and a note that a typed name in the signature block is sufficient under s.15.16, F.S. None of it describes what a third party may file on an entity's behalf, any authorization or delegation form, filer roles, or which signatures must stay personal. Changing the registered agent or officer list is an adjacent feature, not a published delegation policy.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
